notes.title: Greengrocer Simulator 2024 – First Bug Fix Update!
notes.content:
Greengrocer Simulator 2024 – First Bug Fix Update! 🚜✨

Hello dear players!

Our first update is now live! 🎉 With this update, we've made several important fixes to make the game more stable and enjoyable. Here are the changes made:

Mission conflicts have been resolved and missions have been further detailed to provide smoother progression. ✅
The physics system has been updated, preventing possible issues and collisions, especially with the forklift. 🚧
Language translation issues and text errors have been fixed, providing more accurate translations. 🌍
Save system issue fixed: The game now automatically saves when transitioning to the new map. 💾
Shadow issues have been fixed and visual quality improvements have been made. 🌟
And many other small bug fixes have been implemented. 🔧
We are grateful for your feedback! 🙏 If you encounter any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

We will continue improving the game with your valuable feedback! 💚
